rules.returns: Price returns from comparable historical index closes (dividends excluded), closest at/before 7/30/91 calendar days; lookback missing if >12 days gap
rules.relative3m: sector 3m return minus NIFTY 50 3m return, percentage points
rules.acceleration: latest 30 calendar-day price return minus preceding 30 calendar-day price return, percentage points
rules.notCapitalFlow: Index prices/rankings cannot prove FPI/DII sector purchases or institutional inflows; compare NSDL sector flow figures separately
rules.missingData: If archive or Yahoo access fails, no returns are invented; show null and source status
